messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — console 'Dry Run' for runtime configs is behaving inconsistently with the API dry-run. Observed different cohort sampling and no telemetry emitted for some keys. Anyone seen this?

maya: Yup saw it earlier when enabling route-by-cost as a dry-run. Console preview showed hits but telemetry pipeline had gaps.

sam: Do we have a clear contract for what 'dry-run' means? I thought API dry-run = no side effects + emits telemetry with tag `dryrun:true` so we can evaluate.

kim: That's what I expected too. Current console preview seems to do a lightweight shadow apply but doesn't spike quota usage, which is fine, but it also doesn't write telemetry unless you hit "apply to preview cohort". Confusing.

alex: Example: POST /v1/runtime/apply?dry_run=true returns 200 with preview id but our metrics only show preview-ui events not the same histogram as normal routing metrics. We need comparable telemetry to evaluate cost/latency.

sam: Agree. For rollouts we need token-level latency/cost histograms, error rates, and route decision breakdown for the preview cohort. Otherwise we can't trust dry-run analysis.

maya: Two proposals: 1) Make dry-run write all telemetry with tagging and route decisions but not increment usage counters. 2) Keep telemetry minimal and provide a replay mode to synthesize metrics from traces. I'm leaning to (1).

kim: (1) makes ops comfortable because we can see real routing decisions; but product/legal might worry about "no side effects" promise if some downstream systems react to telemetry. Need to confirm downstream consumers won't treat dry-run metrics as billable.

alex: We can set a header X-Redwood-Dryrun: true and have downstream consumers treat those metrics as non-billable. Add a strict label in schema: {"redwood.preview": "dryrun"}.

opsbot: NOTE: any dryrun-emitted telemetry will be tagged. Please ensure dashboards filter on `redwood.preview` to avoid mixing.

sam: UX question: Console currently shows "Preview: 1k requests" but that's based on sampling. We should surface sampling rate and an estimated true count (extrapolated). Also show expected quota impact if promoted.

maya: +1. Also show confidence interval. We have telemetry samples for decisions but not for token counts. Need token-level instrumentation in shadow path to estimate cost delta.

kim: Implementation detail: runtime agent already has a shadow path hook. It can optionally compute token deltas without persisting model outputs. That should be cheap on p99. We'll need a flag `shadow.compute_token_delta` default false.

alex: OK plan: 1) Add API contract: dry_run emits full decision telemetry tagged with redwood.preview=dryrun, does not increment billing counters. 2) Console: surface sampling rate, estimated extrapolated counts, confidence intervals, and token-cost estimates. 3) Runtime: add shadow token-delta calc behind flag. 4) Downstream: filter dashboards by preview tag by default.

sam: Who owns the schema? telemetry-team or eng-platform? We need a short PR with examples before we start shipping.

maya: Telemetry-team should own the schema, eng-platform implements client tagging. I'll draft the schema change and include sample grafana queries + dashboard panel configs.

kim: Small caveat: we need to ensure preview cohorts are stable across config change churn. Suggest using sticky cohort ids and recording config-hash in telemetry so we can correlate.

alex: Good call. Add fields: preview.cohort_id and config.hash. Also show rollout TTL and sample rate in UI.

console-bot: ACTION: maya to open telemetry-schema PR; kim to add runtime flag and proof-of-concept; alex to update API docs; sam to draft console UI copy. ETA EOW?

maya: I'll open the PR today with schema + example queries.

kim: I'll spike the runtime flag tomorrow and post results in this thread.

sam: I'll start a small UX doc for console panels and copy.

alex: Thanks all. If we want a quick safety, we'll gate dry-run telemetry emission behind an org-level opt-in for first rollout. Better safe. :thumbsup:

maya: Agreed — opt-in for orgs until we've validated downstream filters.

opsbot: REMINDER: please add a telemetry migration runbook for preview tags and update ops playbooks before enabling org-wide.

alex: Cool, we'll follow-up in the PR and aim to have a small pilot next week.
